name: RL game bot for a hidden-information turn game

mentions.name: RL game bot for a hidden-information turn game
mentions.description: A game bot built with a reinforcement learning approach for a turn-based game with a lot of hidden information. Inspired by the pluto bot that won a major bot tournament, it aims to see how far such a bot can get on a much smaller budget than the tens of thousands of dollars reportedly spent on similar bots.
mentions.problem: Competitive game bots are expensive, with prior tournament-winning bots reportedly costing tens of thousands of dollars to build.
mentions.source_excerpt: I always was fascinated by ai in games and seeing https://github.com/tscmoo/pluto win major bot tournament I wanted to try my hand at building one with RL approach. I am hoping that it won't cost too much as it seems they were able to do it for tens of thousand of dollars? I wanted to see how far I would get with much smaller budget but in a turn game with a lot of hidden information.
mentions.author: mixnix
